partner_result_applied.applied_inequality: ||p_Q||_infinity <= C_off |det B|^(-1/3), C_off=4.8117455951457755..., for invertible zero-diagonal physical triples with arbitrary outside couplings

projection_dependency.claim: sharp two-dimensional product projection density cap <=2

new_results.statement: For exact rank three A=R Lambda R^T with R^TR=I_3 and fixed physical pair i,j, sum_{k != i,j}|det A_{ijk}|=|det Lambda| (|r_i|^2|r_j|^2-<r_i,r_j>^2).
After Gram-Schmidt, normalized transverse coefficients l_k satisfy sum l_k^2=1, ||p_{sum l_kX_k}||_infinity<=2, and |det A_{ijk}|=P_ij l_k^2 with P_ij=|det Lambda|G_ij.
If a zero-diagonal eligible triple has l_k^2>=tau, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= C_off tau^(-1/3) P_ij^(-1/3).
For local partner costs M_k=C_off(P_ij l_k^2)^(-1/3), sum_{eligible}M_k^(-3)=C_off^(-3)P_ij sum_{eligible}l_k^2.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-CUBIC-BANK-AGGREGATION-v1: turn the capped normalized original-coordinate bank plus its exact determinant weights into a joint nonlinear curved-trace estimate before reciprocal local-minor payment; then extend beyond exact rank three.
